metrics.label: 退款率
metrics.description: 退款订单数 ÷ 已支付订单数（按单量计算，不是按金额）。

notes: 数据范围：华南（行级权限由系统强制执行，结果只包含你有权限的数据）。

answer.text: 上个月（2026年9月），华南区的退款率为 6.4%（退款订单数 17 单，订单数 265 单）。

queries.title: 退款率
queries.sql:
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.status = 'refunded' THEN o.order_id END) AS refunded_orders,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count,
  ROUND(
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.status = 'refunded' THEN o.order_id END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 0),
    4
  ) AS refund_rate
FROM orders AS o
JOIN regions AS r
  ON o.region_id = r.region_id
WHERE
  o.status IN ('paid', 'refunded')
  AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
  AND r.region_name = '华南'
LIMIT 1000
queries.executed_sql:
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.status = 'refunded' THEN o.order_id END) AS refunded_orders,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count,
  ROUND(
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.status = 'refunded' THEN o.order_id END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 0),
    4
  ) AS refund_rate
FROM (
  SELECT
    channel,
    customer_id,
    discount_amount,
    gross_amount,
    order_date,
    order_id,
    pay_amount,
    refund_amount,
    region_id,
    status,
    store_id
  FROM orders
  WHERE
    region_id IN ('south')
) AS o
JOIN (
  SELECT
    region_id,
    region_name
  FROM regions
  WHERE
    region_id IN ('south')
) AS r
  ON o.region_id = r.region_id
WHERE
  o.status IN ('paid', 'refunded')
  AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
  AND r.region_name = '华南'
LIMIT 1000
